bulk_bounds:

(set-option :timeout 5000)
(declare-const a Int)
(declare-const b Int)
(declare-const neighbors Int)
(assert (and (>= a -2147483648) (<= a 2147483647) (>= b -2147483648) (<= b 2147483647)

(define-fun n () Int (+ a (* 7 b) neighbors))

  (ite (< n 0) (- (div (+ (- n) 6) 12)) (div (+ n 6) 12)))
(assert (or (< rounded -2147483648) (> rounded 2147483647)))
(check-sat)
